title: 电费涨超通胀两倍：宾州选民不买账，关键选区风向生变
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Power bills have become central to US politics, and a way that experts say is completely unprecedented in modern history.
segments.zh: 电费已成为美国政治的核心议题，专家称这在现代史上完全前所未有。

segments.en: In this chart, we can see the average electricity demand across US cities, from 2010 to this year.
segments.zh: 这张图展示了2010年至今美国各城市的平均电力需求。

segments.en: Last year alone, we saw electricity prices rise by more than double the rate of inflation.
segments.zh: 仅去年一年，电价涨幅就超过通胀率的两倍。

segments.en: The cost of electricity is to the 2026 election, what the price of eggs was, to the 2024 races.
segments.zh: 电力成本对2026年选举的影响，就像鸡蛋价格对2024年选战的影响一样。

segments.en: The warning round also is upending global energy markets, making not just power, but fuel costs a political issue.
segments.zh: 警告周期也在颠覆全球能源市场，使电力乃至燃料成本都成为政治议题。

segments.en: We're here in Pennsylvania's seventh district, stocked voters. This is a swing district.
segments.zh: 我们来到宾夕法尼亚州第七选区，这里选民立场摇摆，是个关键选区。

segments.en: How this race goes is going to say a lot about the US midterms.
segments.zh: 这场选举的结果将很大程度上反映美国中期选举的走向。

segments.en: Republicans are fighting to hold on to a razor thin margin in Congress, and Pennsylvania's seventh is a crucial bellweather for how this issue of power bills is going to play out in the midterms.
segments.zh: 共和党正努力保住国会中的微弱优势，而宾州第七选区是电费议题如何影响中期选举的关键风向标。

segments.en: Last year, Democrats cleaned up. They swept a victory in Georgia, New Jersey, and Virginia.
segments.zh: 去年民主党大获全胜，在佐治亚、新泽西和弗吉尼亚州均取得胜利。

segments.en: And the issue all came down to one really important thing, power bills.
segments.zh: 而问题都归结于一件非常重要的事：电费。

segments.en: Pennsylvania's seen a 40% increase in its electricity costs since 2020, and voters here are really mad about that.
segments.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州自2020年以来电费上涨了40%，这里的选民对此非常不满。

segments.en: I've been a resident of Slatington, Pennsylvania for 31 years.
segments.zh: 我在宾夕法尼亚州斯莱廷顿住了31年。
